title: Passive Voice: Two Objects Practice — Quiz 107
content:
## Passive Voice: Two Objects Practice

Make passive sentences with verbs that take two objects.

### Lesson focus

1. He gave me a story book.
2. Papa bought us toffees.
3. Grandmother tells us interesting stories.
4. The police will ask you many questions.

### Understand the pattern

With two-object verbs, distinguish the recipient from the thing given or communicated. Give, tell and ask can allow the recipient to become the passive subject. If the thing becomes the subject, a preposition may be needed before the recipient.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. I was given a storybook; a storybook was given to me.
2. Toffees were bought for us.
3. We are told interesting stories; interesting stories are told to us.
4. You will be asked many questions; many questions will be asked of you.

Buy normally uses for when the purchased item is the passive subject.

### Try another

Change: She sent Ravi a letter, starting with A letter.

### Suggested answer

A letter was sent to Ravi. To marks the recipient of something sent. Do not automatically use for with every two-object verb.
